tasks.title: Announcement #31
tasks.instruction: Listen to an announcement in a classroom.
tasks.transcript: Woman: Please note that we will not be meeting on Friday. I just received a last-minute invitation to present at a conference this weekend, and I'll be flying on Friday. I know that you were going to start your presentations then. Julie and Max, we'll just move you to Monday, and those scheduled for Monday will move to Wednesday, and so on. This will actually give everyone a few extra days to work on your presentations.

questions.stem: What will the speaker be doing on Friday?

options.D: Giving a presentation to her colleagues

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问说话者周五将做什么，属于细节理解题，需抓住女士对周五安排的直接说明。 选项分析 选项A：正确。 女士明确说“I'll be flying on Friday”，因为要去参加周末的会议做报告，所以周五在飞行途中，即前往会议的路上。 选项B：错误。 原计划周五学生开始做展示，但因老师不在，课程取消，因此她不会听学生展示。 选项C：错误。 对话中没有提到批改学生作业，属于无中生有。 选项D：错误。 女士要去会议上做报告（present at a conference），而非给同事做报告，属于对象错误。

questions.stem: What can be concluded about Julie and Max?

options.A: They asked for extra time to work on a project.
options.C: They will have to miss class on Monday.
options.D: They are the first students who will give presentations.

questions.analysis: 题干分析 问题询问关于Julie和Max可以得出什么结论，属于推理判断题，需抓住女士对展示顺序的调整安排。 选项分析 选项A：错误。 调整是因为老师临时有事，而非Julie和Max主动要求更多时间，属于因果错误。 选项B：错误。 对话中没有提到Julie和Max最近参加了会议，属于无中生有。 选项C：错误。 他们的展示被调到周一，说明周一他们要上课做展示，而非缺课。 选项D：正确。 女士说“Julie and Max, we'll just move you to Monday”，而原计划周五开始展示，周五被取消后他们调到周一，说明他们原本是周五第一批展示的学生。
